campaign.title: Terminal top-shell determinant-residue resonant-mode gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: No external theorem is assumed in Round 131. Any proposed Salie, Kloosterman, trace-function, decoupling, or large-sieve continuation is only an interface statement pending a separate source card.

frozen_target.question: On the sole exponent-critical B asymp D shell, can the exact physically reassembled determinant-residue weight be legally separated into periodic and BV factors, can its shifted family-level resonant mode be computed, and does that computation yield a literal signed bank, a physical obstruction, or a terminal degeneracy verdict?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Use the exact one-sided post-inner scalar in blind_statement.md, reindex after physical Mobius reassembly by n=aq-bp, and retain actual outer coefficients, M1/M2 character placement, Stieltjes thresholds, reciprocal aliases, determinant taper, stars, signs, cells, and owners before the decisive estimate.
quantities: strict global improvement requires a complete exponent below 9/16 and therefore a cross-ray gain

completion_criteria: Write the exact n=aq-bp reindexing of the physically reassembled top-shell scalar before any positive norm.
Prove or refute a periodic-arithmetic versus BV-envelope separation modulo 4|a|, with every threshold, taper, support face, and owner priced.
Compute the shifted physical resonant mode for M1 and M2 rather than assuming the naive zero mode.
Decide from exact algebra whether a genuine quadratic-Gauss or Salie-class complete sum occurs, including modulus, unit condition, completion formula, and boundary cost.
Price the resonant-window mass and test the accepted same-denominator M1/M2 aligned packets, including the M2 sign-crossing convention.
Distinguish per-ray residue cancellation from the family-summed cross-ray theorem required to cross the persistence threshold.
Close under exactly one terminal label: bank, obstruct, or degenerate. No second internal per-ray top-shell round is authorized.
Make no global exponent, M9 component, endpoint, bridge, or quarter promotion.

tasks.target: From the statement-only packet, derive the weakest legal periodic/BV separation and shifted resonant-mode statement, then prove a residue saving, construct a matched obstruction, or give the sharp no-go.
excluded_context: all Round-95 through Round-131 nonblind artifacts
required_output: A legal separation lemma or an exact reason it cannot be stated from the supplied hypotheses.
A shifted-mode computation, matched control, and exact capacity.

tasks.target: Derive the literal M1/M2 determinant-residue weight after physical reassembly, prove the periodic/BV separation with a variation ledger, identify the shifted resonant mode and any Salie-class algebra, and estimate the family-summed resonant contribution or isolate the first exact residual.
required_output: The exact induced residue formula and separation/variation ledger.
A bank theorem, physical obstruction, or terminal degeneracy result with first residual.

tasks.target: Hostilely test every proposed resonant cancellation against the exact same-denominator M1/M2 packets, sign crossings, threshold ordering, window mass, family-level cross-ray capacity, and the scalar-versus-energy distinction.
required_output: An exact seam matrix and at least one literal aligned-packet calculation.
Certification, scope correction, or rigorous no-go.

review_seams.requirement: No residue Fourier expansion precedes physical Mobius and Stieltjes reassembly or the periodic/BV separation lemma.
M1 denominator carriers and M2 numerator characters are pulled through n=aq-bp in their literal coordinates.
The shifted physical resonant mode and same-denominator aligned packets are both computed.
Threshold equality, support births and deaths, stars, determinant diagonal, sign crossings, and half-open top-shell ownership are charged once.
A single actual family scalar is not replaced by an arbitrary positive energy or operator norm.
Every bank displays its exponent relative to 35/48, 31/48, 27/48, and 24/48 and identifies whether the gain is per-ray or cross-ray.

closing_assessment.main_result: The fixed-p primitive support masks have exact divisor-cost Gauss-times-Ramanujan and Ramanujan transforms, but the weighted physical factorization, interlaced BV ledger, and actual cross-ray scalar estimate remain open.
